source.credit: AT&T Laboratories Cambridge; modified Olivetti faces by Sam Roweis
source.description: 400 different captures of 40 subjects, ten views per subject
source.usage_notice: Credit AT&T Laboratories Cambridge when using these images

processing: uint8 pixels preserved, orientation corrected from MATLAB layout, Lanczos resize 64x64 to 128x128
target_origin: fixed photographs prepared before DOE optimization
target_quantity: grayscale amplitude target under the project's peak-normalized abs(U) convention
split_rule: disjoint subject identities; each of the 400 source captures used exactly once

search.objective: PCC and global SSIM, 0.7 mean plus 0.3 worst-plane for each
search.selection: maximum min of all 8 exported PCC/global SSIM values, mean score breaks ties
